. --fadmonitions ```````````````````````````````` ## Numeric entity for surrogate code point Surrogate code points (U+D800..U+DFFF) are not valid Unicode scalar values and must be replaced with U+FFFD, like U+0000. ```````````````````````````````` example � � � � .

� � � �

```````````````````````````````` ## Backslash + newline as soft line break inside a link title Per CommonMark, a backslash before a line ending is a recognized escape that produces a soft line break. This must work inside link titles too -- the HTML renderer doesn't distinguish soft breaks from regular newlines, but a custom renderer would, so the parser must treat `\\` + newline as an escape rather than a literal backslash followed by content. ```````````````````````````````` example [foo]: /url "ti\ tle" [foo] .
